title: shellViteConfig
responsibility: Builds one isolated shell fixture page and publishes its catalog data with the bundle, keeping media references bound to their original bytes.

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: The default Vite configuration, a function that resolves the config when Vite loads it, for the one shell fixture page that SHELL_FIXTURE_PAGE names (navbar when unset). It builds tests/e2e/support/shell/<page>Entry.ts to SHELL_FIXTURE_OUT or output/shell-fixture/<page> as one iife script named ShellFixture with the file name page, CSS code splitting off, no public directory, warn-level logging and process.env.NODE_ENV defined as 'production'. The components and catalog pages alias the SvelteKit $app modules and the $desktop, $shared and $reports paths to fixture and package sources. The catalog page also gets its preview data by running buildData with Bun, defines it as __COMPONENT_PREVIEW_DATA__, emits it as preview-data.json, and blanks the app style sheets that the catalog host installs itself. The plugins contain hooks that JSON cannot express.

errors.name: execFile rejection
errors.description: For the catalog page only, the config function rejects with the execFile error when the bun -e run of buildData fails or its output exceeds 16 MiB.
